title: Resolution urging Albany to classify Medical Examiner vehicles as emergency vehicles
summary: This resolution calls on the state legislature to pass A.11075, the Senate to pass a companion bill, and the Governor to sign it, classifying New York City Office of Chief Medical Examiner vehicles as authorized emergency vehicles. The change would let these vehicles use emergency lights and treat scenes where the office responds as emergency operations, aiming to speed up response times. The office testified at a City Council budget hearing that this change would improve its scene response.
